name: android_check_crash
description: Inspects the Android dedicated crash buffer (-b crash), runtime fatal exceptions, or ANRs for a target package, returning clean crash traces.

deviceSerial.description: Device serial or IP:port from android_list_devices. Required when several devices are connected; may be omitted when only one is.

package.description: Target application package name to filter crash logs for.

limit.description: Maximum number of crash log lines to retrieve (default 50).
